requirements.name: App shows a heading
requirements.description: The app renders a heading with the text "Users".

requirements.name: Users load on mount
requirements.description: The component fetches /api/users when it mounts and renders the returned names.
requirements.hint: Call fetch('/api/users') inside a useEffect with an empty dependency array and render the response.

requirements.name: List contains Alice
requirements.description: The rendered list contains the item "Alice".
requirements.hint: Map over the fetched users and render one list item per user.

requirements.name: List does not contain an unreturned user
requirements.description: A user that the API never returns must not appear in the list.
requirements.hint: Only render users returned by the API — never hard-code them.

requirements.name: Loading indicator disappears
requirements.description: Once the users have loaded, the "Loading..." text is no longer rendered.
requirements.hint: Keep a loading state and switch from the loading text to the list after the fetch resolves.

requirements.name: Fetch mock serves the right data
requirements.description: The mocked GET /api/users route returns the declared body.
requirements.hint: The fetch assertion mocks the declared routes; the component must fetch /api/users with GET.

requirements.name: Creating a user uses the POST method
requirements.description: Submitting the create form sends a POST request to /api/users.
requirements.hint: Call fetch('/api/users', { method: 'POST', ... }) in the form's submit handler.

requirements.name: Creating a user sends the right body
requirements.description: The create request body contains the typed name.
requirements.hint: Send JSON.stringify({ name }) with a Content-Type of application/json.

requirements.name: Creating a user updates the UI
requirements.description: After submitting the create form, the new user appears and the input clears.
requirements.hint: Append the created user to the list in state and reset the name input.

requirements.name: Updating a user sends a PUT request
requirements.description: Clicking Edit and saving a new name sends a PUT request to /api/users/1.
requirements.hint: Track the editing user in state and fetch `/api/users/${editingId}` with method PUT.

requirements.name: Updating a user replaces the name in the UI
requirements.description: After saving an edit, the old name is gone and the new name is shown.
requirements.hint: Replace the edited user in the list with the response object.

requirements.name: Deleting a user sends a DELETE request
requirements.description: Clicking Delete sends a DELETE request to /api/users/1.
requirements.hint: Call fetch(`/api/users/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' }) in the delete handler.

requirements.name: Deleting a user removes the item
requirements.description: After clicking Delete, the removed user is no longer in the list.
requirements.hint: Filter the removed user out of the list in state.
